Liberation War to feature in Qawmi books
2021-12-13T00:00:00+06:00 | Staff Correspondent
https://www.thedailystar.net/news/bangladesh/news/liberation-war-feature-qawmi-books-2915966

Authorities of a section of Qawmi madrasas are set to include topics of Language Movement, struggle for freedom as well as Liberation War in the textbooks for primary-level students.

At a press conference yesterday, leaders of Jatiya Qawmi Madrasa Shikkha Board, Bangladesh, said students of pre-primary to class-III would get the textbooks containing the topics from January 1.

"About 1.11 lakh students enrolled in more than 500 [madrasas under the board] will get the books … this is unprecedented steps for the Qawmi madrasa. It is really a matter of regret that the nation has to wait for 50 years for having such important topics in the textbooks," Mufti Syed Usama Islam, secretary general of the board, said at the briefing held at the National Press Club.

Board officials said Bangla, general knowledge, Bangladesh and Biswa Parichiti books will have the topics on struggle for freedom and Liberation War.

Qawmi madrasas have so far been an uncharted territory with no government monitoring, supervision or support. They mostly run with private donations.

These madrasas operate under several education boards run privately. They are said to follow the syllabus of Darul Uloom Deoband, a historic Islamic school of India, focusing mainly on Arabic, Persian and Urdu languages.

It is understood they don't teach science, social science, math and literature. Only a handful of Qawmi madrasas teach Bangla and English up to class-VIII.
